output.summary: This fourth amendment lets Goldstar Foods supply more groceries to the district's Nutrition Services Department. It adds up to $1,500,000, raising the contract's not-to-exceed amount from $6,269,349.25 to $7,769,349.25. The term stays July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023.

The agreement runs January 2, 2023 through June 30, 2023, and the board is approving it after the start date.

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $10,000.00

The agreement runs January 3, 2023 through July 31, 2023.

output.headline: Extends a consultant's work on a possible administrator credential program to June 30, 2023, same $25,000 cap
output.summary: This amendment extends the agreement for 167 hours of consulting on whether the district could build its own administrator credential program (preliminary or clear administrative services). output.headline: Adds $5,401 and two months for Sandis to inspect stormwater protection at Castlemont field project

money.evidence: in an additional amount of $5,401.00

It also extends the contract end date from February 28, 2023 to April 30, 2023, an additional 61 calendar days.

output.summary: This memorandum of understanding with the University of Southern California's Rossier School of Education sets up an intern partnership and practicum program.
